tests.prompt: add a mermaid diagram of the auth flow to the README
tests.rationale: Plain in-repo Mermaid authoring is the core use case.

tests.prompt: create a sequence diagram for our login flow
tests.rationale: Sequence diagrams with no other tool named default to Mermaid via this skill.

tests.prompt: this mermaid flowchart renders with the subgraphs stacked vertically, fix it
tests.rationale: Repairing broken/mis-rendering Mermaid diagrams is an explicit trigger, covered by layout-troubleshooting.md.

tests.prompt: draw a state machine for the ticket lifecycle statuses
tests.rationale: State diagrams are a supported type in the pattern catalogue.

tests.prompt: turn this Mermaid flowchart into a Lucidchart diagram
tests.rationale: Delivery into Lucid belongs to the lucid-diagram plugin, not Mermaid authoring.

tests.prompt: draw a sequence diagram in FigJam
tests.rationale: FigJam diagrams belong to the Figma tooling, not Mermaid.

tests.prompt: plot a bar chart of monthly sales from this CSV
tests.rationale: Data-dense charts are an explicit non-goal; the skill itself says to use a real charting tool.

tests.prompt: add a kanban board diagram of our sprint backlog to the docs
tests.rationale: Newer Mermaid diagram types (kanban) are covered by diagram-patterns.md Pattern 20 and must trigger the same as the established types.

tests.prompt: draw an architecture diagram of our AWS services in mermaid
tests.rationale: Cloud/CI-CD topology maps to architecture-beta (Pattern 21) — confirms the newest diagram-type additions are reachable via natural language, not just exact keyword prompts.

tests.prompt: my mermaid node label has a line break in it but it renders as a literal backslash-n instead of two lines, fix it
tests.rationale:
Exercises the `
` vs `\n` multi-line label rule (SKILL.md Step 4, layout-troubleshooting.md catalogue) as a repair request, not just fresh authoring.

tests.prompt: I need this mermaid diagram embedded as an image in our Marp slide deck since Marp can't render mermaid fences live
tests.rationale: Non-native-renderer targets route to exporting-to-svg.md (SVG export + width/max-width patch) rather than a plain fenced code block.
